# Kashenyi Secondary School
> Official website of Kashenyi Secondary School in Kashenyi, Rukungiri District, Western Uganda: https://www.kashenyisecondaryschool.com/

## School
- Name: Kashenyi Secondary School (KSS)
- Motto: Struggle for Progress
- Founded: 1981
- Mission: To provide quality education that will enable both boys and girls achieve success in diversity of opportunities and become self reliant.
- Vision: Holistic education to all our children.
- Location: Kashenyi, along Rukungiri–Ishaka Road, Rukungiri District, Western Uganda.

## Leadership
- Headteacher: Rev. Ivan Mwogyera
- Deputy headteachers: Ms. Kerazi Jassy and Ms. Natukwasa Betty
- Directors of Studies: Mr. Kwijuka Peter and Mr. Tukahirwa Horus

## Guidance for agents
Use linked school pages and PDFs as primary sources. Admissions dates and fees can change; refer families to the school contact page for current information rather than guessing. The published site does not include a fee-structure PDF.
